profile.org_note: Founder-owned group run from 500 Stonehenge Parkway, Dublin, OH. Two arms share one executive team: a company-owned homebuilder (six markets, each a state affiliate that holds every community in its own single-member project LLC) and a franchisor, Epcon Communities Franchising, LLC, that licenses the product to 60+ independent builders. Land and capital decisions sit with CEO Joel Rhoades, CFO/Treasurer David Blackmore, an operations executive (Brooks Longfellow) and the two founder co-chairmen, all of whom are officers of every project LLC; no VP or Director of Land is named publicly and current market leaders are confirmed only for Raleigh (2023 and older names for Columbus, Atlanta and Nashville are tagged Inferred in the people list).
profile.email_pattern: first initial + last name @epconcommunities.com (e.g. rkrohn@epconcommunities.com); based on two published addresses
profile.summary: Private, founder-owned builder of single-storey courtyard homes for 55+ buyers, and a homebuilding franchisor (its franchising site calls it the largest US homebuilding franchise by closed units). The Builder 100 figure (1,269 closings, about $825M) is the whole system: per CEO Joel Rhoades in May 2026, the company-owned arm closed just under 600 homes last year in six markets (Columbus, Charlotte, Raleigh, Indianapolis, Atlanta, Nashville) and 60+ franchise builders in 20+ states closed a little over 600. For a land banker the addressable customer is the roughly 600-home corporate arm (average 2024 settlement price about $721K), which buys and develops its own land through single-purpose project LLCs; franchisees are separate small builders that finance their own land.

He is both the finance head and the treasury contact; no separate treasurer or capital-markets officer is public. Reporting line inferred from titles.
